verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an API, authenticated with a single access_token key, that offers payment links as an available feature, along with charges that carry a value. That covers the payment-link and amount parts of the story, and the sandbox lets an agent test flows safely. There is no evidence of distinct product or price catalog objects that can be provisioned via the API. The MCP server only lets an assistant query the documentation, not perform API actions. Missing for 10: documented product/price creation endpoints, a payment-link creation API reference tying a link to a product/price, an end-to-end agent provisioning example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
